question: Which operational distinctions must candidate value representations and inference rules preserve, as shown by at least six explicit separating examples?
scope: F01 only: examples, fixed versus optional commitments, concise project/claim/notation records, timing ledger, small executable witnesses. No choice of calculus, F02 completion, or gate pass.
reliable_gain: Explicit hand-checked counterexamples to context-free rankings and scalar-summary composition, with exact arithmetic fixtures.
exploratory_gain: Determine which compositional summaries can suffice without retaining an entire model, and how toy axiom systems and unbounded values constrain representations without fixing them.
likely_failure: Conflating a failure of one lossy numerical evaluation with an impossibility for all scalar encodings; or importing a carrier/consequence relation before requirements are established.
discriminating_check: Paired inputs with identical proposed summaries but different required outputs; positive restricted-summary examples and explicit adapter/context access.
stop_rule: If the response must end before D60, persist substantive partial work and measured totals; do not waive the floor or advance F02.
